author: 067Bandit
body:
Dear Avicus,

It has been a year since I was wrongfully permanently banned from your server. I admit to using mild profanities but the punishment was utterly ridiculous.

First I was kicked, which I think is reasonable, but then as soon as I logged in again without saying anything I was kicked again. It then happened again and when I re-logged in for the 3rd time I received a message saying I had been permanently kicked. 

I miss the days when I would play on your server so much. Just because of a few glitches in the system I lost access to my favourite server.

I promise I will not use profanities at all if I am allowed onto your server, and I will be a positive teammate in mini games. I have changed since my permanent ban, and I am a much more mature person.

My username was Luke067 when I was banned, and it was by SnowSX3.

replies.body: Hello! The Staff Member who punished you is no longer Staff, so I will escalate your appeal and only Senior Moderators will be the only staff  responding after this post. Good Luck on your appeal!

replies.author: GrapeSmoothie
replies.body:
Hey 067Bandit,

Since you have been banned for quite a while I have decided to give you another chance and appeal your ban.
Please update yourself with the rules as they may have changed a bit since your last time on avicus. 

Regards,
GrapeSmoothie :: Senior Moderator
